It declares constant names, offsets, types, descriptions, and converters for counters such as `sock_syscalls_sendmmsg`, `sock_syscalls_recvmmsg`, `sock_rx_pkt_cnt`, `sock_tx_pkt_cnt`, `sock_tx_drop_cnt`, `sock_tx_bytes_total`, and `sock_rx_bytes_total`.
